scope: Atlas classification timing and separately traced HermiT correctness checks
scale: 15 ORE 2015 DL development ontologies, Gene Ontology and ChEBI lite

settings.scope: One process per file, arm and thread count, with a 13 GiB systemd scope without swap

arms.l0: new binary with the old rule bodies
arms.l1: new binary with guarded R7 and reduced copying
arms.l2: new binary with default Horn rules
arms.base-el: old binary with --el-only on the four main files
arms.el: new binary with --el-only on the four main files

method: Within each round, compute the ratio of the two process medians. Report the median of the six ratios, their range, and the two-sided percentile interval over all 46656 six-pair resamples with replacement. Median added time is the median of paired differences. Odd and even rounds used reverse arm orders.
